name: e2e-test-deadlines
goal: Two tests stop failing on machine load: liveness expiry is proven by an aged stored heartbeat under a realistic TTL, and subprocess tests state their own execution deadlines.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Full check: activity E2E stale after a legitimate heartbeat and two 5 s timeouts; tall JPEG case 5 s timeout. Both pass alone. Spec: specification/features/planned/e2e-test-deadlines.md.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Frozen tests: roster delayed 1.5 s in memory gives stale-not-working and a 5 s timeout; Python started 2.5 s late times out both JPEG cases. /tmp/harness-test-robustness/*-red.log

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Tests only: heartbeat aged through AgentRegistryRepository under a 600 s allowance; literal deadlines of 60 s and 30 s. 25 earlier assertions verbatim, 2 added; JPEG body unchanged.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same delays: activity 7 passed, JPEG 2 passed; alone 7 and 2. Two liveness mutants in a copy each fail the heartbeat case. Format, lint, root typecheck, root and reports audits pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
